mapper.select: select m.id, m.parent_id, m.path, m.route_name, m.`name`, m.component, m.param, m.iframe, m.cache, m.state, m.visible, m.redirect, m.icon, m.menu_type, ifnull(m.power,'') as power, m.sort, m.description, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.deleted from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('CATALOG', 'MENU') and m.state = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.sort

select m.id, m.parent_id, m.path, m.route_name, m.`name`, m.component, m.param, m.iframe, m.cache, m.state, m.visible, m.redirect, m.icon, m.menu_type, ifnull(m.power,'') as power, m.sort, m.description, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.deleted from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.id left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.id where u.id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('MENU', 'VIEW') and m.state = 0 AND ro.state = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.sort

SELECT power FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role ro ON ur.role_id = ro.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0
